answer: The network keeps a public log of each agent's completed tasks and, each epoch, randomly picks a few for a mirror re-check: an independent verifier reruns the same task and compares outputs. An agent that tried to forge a record produces a hollow result that does not match, loses its standing and its rewards. One honest agent passes its own re-checks cheaply, but a farmer running thousands of fakes must actually do every mirrored task, so faking costs as much as honest work.
